messages:
maya: quick UI debate  we have two options for the spend chart legends: collapsed pill list vs an inline table. collapsed pills save space but make scanning numbers harder. thoughts?

oscar: inline table is easier for power users scanning cost by model name. pills are friendlier for newcomers. could we hybrid: show top 3 inline, rest in a pill overflow "+3 more"?

lina: hybrid seems good. need to make overflow accessible: the popover must trap focus and be dismissible with escape. Also ensure screen readers can access the hidden items.

keith: engineering note: popover for overflow should be reusable component we already have. but we need to ensure it doesn't break when chart is in narrow mobile width. maybe make overflow full-width modal on small screens.

sana: accessibility: pills currently use small text and have low contrast on dark theme. increase font-weight to 600 and bump contrast to 4.5:1. Also add aria-describedby for each pill that includes numerical value readout.

maya: copy for pill hover tooltip: "Model X: $123.45 (0.12% of spend)". inline table shows exact numbers without tooltip.

oscar: curious about sortable legends in inline table (sort by spend). could be useful. but might add complexity for now. maybe add later.

lina: keyboard navigation: tabs should move through pills; arrow keys in popover to move between items. Add role="list" and role="listitem" for semantics.

designbot: uploaded mock: https://assets.redwood/screencap/legend-hybrid.png. shows top3 inline, overflow pill with +X, and modal for mobile.

keith: will reuse PopoverV2 with props: trapFocus=true, fullScreenOnMobile=true. will add analytics event legend_overflow_open.

oscar: question for product: should the legend include model icons? helps visual scanning. but increases clutter.

maya: keep icons optional behind a setting. default no icons for now. we can test later.

sana: ensure icons have alt text if present and aria-hidden if purely decorative.

maya: final decision: hybrid legend, overflow accessible popover, full-screen modal on mobile, no icons by default, top 3 inline with numbers.

keith: i'll implement and add unit tests for keyboard navigation. ETA 3 days.

lina: QA checklist: 1) screen reader reads pill name + value, 2) popover traps focus, 3) escape closes popover, 4) mobile shows full-screen modal.

maya: adding to sprint. designbot will push updated tokens for pill weight.
